findings.quote: Restating both results: the time of flight is 4 s and the range OP is 80√2 m.
findings.note: Duplicated prose: the same two numbers are then printed again in this step's equation and a third time in final_answer. The text of this step should say only what the equation does (combine the two legs).
findings.fix: OP is the straight-line distance from O to P, the hypotenuse of the right triangle with legs x = 80 m and y = 80 m.

notes: Physics checked line by line: x = 20t, y = 5t²; 5t² = 20t → t = 4 s; x = y = 80 m; OP = 80√2 = 113.1 m. g = 10 is assumed in step 1 and stated there; the question gives no g, so this is acceptable. Both mistake entries are genuine and their numbers reproduce (g t² gives t = 2 s, 40√2 = 56.6 m).
